site.name: Qualiacology
site.role: Psychopharmacology researcher, NAMI co-facilitator, and the artist behind Doopliss.
site.thesis: Studying what it feels like to be alive
site.thesisDeck: Psychopharmacology, browser worlds, music, and a 3,000-person community built to learn, help, and connect.
site.description: Psychopharmacology, strange little browser games, murder pop, and a 3,000-person community built to learn, help, and connect. By Alexander Duncan Guitar.

notice.body: I am not a doctor. I'm an insane person on the internet. We try to help as many people as possible here with questions.
notice.lede: But if you really want an answer to a medical question that is not a guess:

rules.title: House rules
rules.copy: Thanks for helping keep the server thoughtful, welcoming, and organized.

items.title: Abide by TOS
items.note: Follow platform rules and community standards.

items.title: No sourcing or selling
items.note: No sourcing to any products or selling.

items.title: Keep recreational drug talk in the recreational channel
items.note: Visit the roles channel to opt in.

items.title: If it could offend someone, post it in the controversial channel
items.note: Visit the roles channel to opt in.

games.title: SIDECHAIN
games.alt: A pink-haired rider crouched low on a hoverboard, carving along a glowing ribbon of pink and orange bubbles above a neon city on the water at night, a huge glossy heart unzipping in the sky behind her
games.summary: Thirty-six songs. One board. Every dip is a downbeat, every hill a bar — pump in time and the record carries you: through a car crash, a candy factory at night, a library where every scream has a surname. Ride it to the last chorus. Keyboard, mouse or thumbs.
games.metaDescription: Thirty-six songs. One board. Every dip is a downbeat, every hill a bar — pump in time and the record carries you: through a car crash, a candy factory at night, a library where every scream has a surname. Ride it to the last chorus. Keyboard, mouse or thumbs.
games.controls: Hold Space or the mouse button to press down, let go to come up · mouse or A/D to steer · at ×4, G goes Groovy · ↑ ↓ pick a song · B riders and boards · Esc pause · P autopilot · on a phone, thumbs
games.duration: An hour and a half or so

games.title: OLLY OLLY
games.alt: A wet street of lit houses on Halloween night: a pumpkin bucket of candy spilled in the gutter, a trail of glowing footprints leading down the road, and at the end of it a giant figure in a bedsheet standing in front of a full moon
games.summary: One Halloween night on Alder Lane. Twelve houses, a churchyard and a forest, scarecrows that get up off the lawns, trick-or-treaters in rubber masks, and something tall in a bedsheet looking for you. Keyboard and mouse.
games.metaDescription: OLLY OLLY is a first-person horror shooter set on one Halloween night on a New England street: twelve houses, a churchyard, a forest, and a tall figure in a bedsheet looking for you.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · Shift sprint · Space jump · C crouch · click fire, right click aim · 1-4 guns · R reload · V kick · Q firecrackers · F flashlight · E use · Tab map

games.title: We Were Promised Morning
games.alt: Through a rain-streaked windscreen at dusk, gaunt long-limbed things with lit eyes stand on a wet back road between the pines, one farmhouse window glowing beyond
games.summary: One county of forest and back roads, and the sun does not come back. Walk or drive between the last lit places, shoot what comes out of the trees, and take a little of the map back every time you get somewhere.
games.metaDescription: We Were Promised Morning is a first-person open-world horror game set in one dark county of forest and back roads where the sun does not come back.
games.controls: WASD + mouse - Shift to sprint - F for the torch - E for the car - headphones recommended

games.title: SPAGHETTI SUNSHINE
games.alt: Three miniature courses made of pasta on a table woven from spaghetti: Bianco Hills with its windmill, Ricco Harbor with its cargo ship and cranes, and Gelato Beach with palms, the Shine Tower and a sand gate
games.summary: The first Shine in Bianco Hills, Ricco Harbor and Gelato Beach. All spaghetti. Even Mario. Clear the road to the windmill, pull Gooper Blooper out of the crates, then find the Dune Bud and cross the crumbling sand castle without FLUDD. Three courses in the same game, with a Shine saved for each. Keyboard and mouse.
games.metaDescription: The first Shine in Bianco Hills, Ricco Harbor and Gelato Beach, reconstructed in pasta. Three courses, separate saved Shines, spray and hover nozzles, Gooper Blooper, and the Dune Bud Sand Castle Secret. Keyboard and mouse.
games.controls: WASD or arrows move · mouse looks · Space jumps · J or click sprays · Shift hovers · Q changes nozzle · hold E to grab, pull back, release to let go · L courses · Esc pause

games.title: SPAGHETTI and AL DENTE
games.descriptor: Two pasta platformers on one table
games.alt: The words AL DENTE in green dry spaghetti standing on a step of dry rods, and SPAGHETTI in golden dry spaghetti in front of it with cooked strands hung over its letters, on a table of stacked dry spaghetti under a layer of cooked
games.summary: Two games on one table. SPAGHETTI: everything is made out of spaghetti. Nothing cannot be spaghetti. You are a twirl of it on two loose ends, side-on, in five levels. AL DENTE: it must all be made of absolutely photorealistic pasta and behave that way too. You are a forkful of cooked spaghetti in four stages, and cooked pasta sticks to cooked pasta, so you can climb the lasagna. Keyboard, and the mouse for AL DENTE.
games.metaDescription: SPAGHETTI and AL DENTE are two browser platformers made entirely of pasta, on one table: a side-scroller in five levels where you are a twirl of spaghetti, and a 3D platformer in four stages where you are a forkful of it that climbs cooked lasagna.
games.controls: on the table: up and down or the mouse pick a game, any key starts it · SPAGHETTI: arrows or A D move, Space jumps, jump into a hanging bunch to swing, Esc pause, again for the nests · AL DENTE: WASD or arrows, Space, drag the mouse or Q E to turn the camera

games.title: SILL
games.descriptor: A fledgling on your real desktop
games.alt: An old cream-painted sash window open on a dark computer desktop. Through it, at sunset, a robin with a worm stands over a nestling in a nest; a speckled fledgling stands on the sill outside, looking back in, and the window's light falls on the desktop below
games.summary: A window opens on your desktop and something falls out of it. It can’t fly yet. It stands on your real windows and rides them when you move them. Get it home, feed it, keep it away from the cat, and then let it go. A Windows download, not a page.
games.metaDescription: SILL is a wordless Windows game that lives on your desktop: an old window opens over your apps, a fledgling falls out of it, and you look after it from summer to winter by moving the window.
games.controls: Windows download · mouse only · drag the window · right-click the bird by the clock to quit

games.title: COLLATERAL
games.alt: A heavy gauntlet with a wheel on the back of the hand, its chain run up to a gold ring on a stone facade under huge arches at sunset
games.summary: Take it. Throw it back. Hold to catch their fire while the world slows, and the gauntlet tears up whatever you look at. Let go and all of it goes back at them. Five districts, one above the next, and the only way up is through the floor. Keyboard and mouse.
games.metaDescription: COLLATERAL is a first-person browser game: catch an army's fire with a gauntlet, tear up the city around you, and throw all of it back. Five districts, a boss in each. Keyboard and mouse.
games.controls: Desktop only · WASD + mouse · hold left to catch, let go to throw · right mouse hooks · Shift dash · Space double jump · C in the air slams

games.title: IN EVERY DIRECTION
games.descriptor: Endless walk through all four seasons
games.alt: A still pond in an autumn wood, red maples and dark spruces round it and reflected in it, cattails along its near edge, two pale trunks close by on the right
games.summary: First person. An autumn forest that goes on forever in every direction, with crunching leaves, piles of leaves and falling leaves. A swing in a huge old tree, a cabin with smoke coming out of the chimney, a bench someone put where the view is, and so many more that it’s impossible to find them all. Walk north and it slowly turns to winter, west into spring, south into summer, and you can get lost in any of them forever. The sun rises in the east and sets in the west, and at night the sky is filled with stars and different animals come out. You can hunt animals with a rifle and catch fish with a fishing rod. No HUD. Keyboard and mouse.
games.metaDescription: IN EVERY DIRECTION is a first-person walk through an autumn forest that goes on forever in every direction. Crunching leaves, piles of leaves, falling leaves, and special places all through it, so many it’s impossible to find them all. Walk north and it turns to winter, west to spring, south to summer, and each of those goes on forever too. The sun rises and sets, and at night the sky is filled with stars and different animals come out. You can hunt animals with a rifle and catch fish with a fishing rod. Keyboard and mouse.
games.controls: Desktop only · mouse looks · WASD or arrows walk · Shift hurries · hold C crouches · C while running slides · Space jumps · 1 fishing rod · 2 rifle · 3 heat goggles · wheel switches · right click aims · E picks up · Esc pause · M mute · F full screen

games.title: THE WAY I CAME
games.descriptor: A salmon swims home up a river
games.alt: A red salmon swimming up into white water in a rocky gorge, standing waves over a stone ledge ahead and two more salmon leaping at it, low sun through the trees beyond
games.summary: A salmon, from the sea at dawn to the gravel where it was born. The water is simulated: it pours over the weirs, curls behind the rocks and races through the gorge. Rest in the slow water, find a way through the fast, and leap from the white water under each step. The others swim with you. Not all of them make it. Keyboard and mouse, or two thumbs on a phone held sideways.
games.metaDescription: THE WAY I CAME is a browser game about a salmon swimming home up a river, from the sea at dawn to the gravel where it was born. The water is simulated: it pours over weirs, curls behind rocks and races through a gorge. Rest in the slow water, find a way through the fast, and leap. Keyboard and mouse, or two thumbs on a phone held sideways.
games.controls: move the mouse to push the ring: where to swim and how hard, all the way out sprints · hold the mouse button or Space to coil, let go to leap · WASD also steers · Esc pause · M mute · F full screen · phone held sideways: left thumb steers, all the way out sprints, hold the right thumb to coil, let go to leap

games.title: KICKMOON
games.alt: An astronaut mid-kick between three small worlds, a blue water moon, a red lava moon and a cratered white one, the ball blazing a trail of fire ahead
games.summary: A boomerang is fun because it comes back. A ball is more fun. Kick it, catch it, and chase it all the way around a moon that is actually round.
games.metaDescription: KICKMOON is a first-person collectathon on a real spherical moon, built around one persistent boomerang ball.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · LMB kick/charge · RMB call it home · MMB grapple · Space double jump · two-thumb touch

games.title: WINTERLINE
games.alt: A snowy city street at night with lit windows down both sides and a Christmas tree at the far end, seen over the barrel of a carbine
games.summary: A Christmas city at night. Run it, climb it, and shoot your way across the rooftops. Take a car when the street is long. The manholes go down and two of the big buildings go all the way up. Keyboard and mouse only.
games.metaDescription: WINTERLINE is a first-person parkour shooter set in a Christmas city at night: sprint, slide, climb the buildings, drive the cars, and go down through the manholes. Keyboard and mouse.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · Shift sprint · Space jump, hold to climb · C slide or crouch · click fire, right click aim · 1 2 3 guns · R reload · F melee · E doors, manholes and cars

games.title: IRON PSALM
games.alt: A prisoner in orange drags an iron ball and chain through a two-storey cell block, with guards and other prisoners ahead
games.summary: The full ball-and-chain prison escape.
games.metaDescription: IRON PSALM — the full ball-and-chain prison escape.
games.controls: WASD move · hold left mouse and circle to swing · right drag or Q/E look · Space brake · R reel in · Shift evade · wheel distance · C centre · Esc pause

games.title: HEARSE
games.alt: A dark church floor seen from above: seven candles on an iron triangle, a small red figure throwing a spinning light on a chain, stained-glass moths, and a rose window with an eye in the middle of it
games.summary: One dark church, seven candles, and a spinning light on a chain. Hold to spin it, let go to throw it, and it comes back. Every hit puts a candle out. A hearse was a candle stand before it was a car. Keyboard and mouse, or two thumbs on a phone held sideways.
games.metaDescription: HEARSE is a one-room browser game in a dark church: spin a light on a chain, throw it, and keep seven candles lit. Keyboard and mouse, or two thumbs on a phone held sideways.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · hold left to spin, let go to throw · click to call it back · Space dash · Esc pause · M mute · phone: sideways, left thumb walks, right thumb aims and throws

games.title: SKIP
games.alt: A stone skimming a bay at dusk past a red-and-white buoy, its ring on the moon’s path across the water, a lighthouse and hills behind
games.summary: Skip a stone off a beach at dusk. Click or tap as it touches the water. If you keep going it travels all the way around the world: the bay, a creek, a town, a church, the ice, the open sea, and back to the beach by morning. Mouse, or one thumb on a phone.
games.metaDescription: SKIP is a stone-skipping browser game: click or tap as the stone touches the water and keep it going all the way around the world, from a bay at dusk back to the beach by morning. Mouse, or one thumb on a phone.
games.controls: click or tap as the stone touches the water · mouse steers · click a stone on the sand or roll the wheel to pick one · phone: tap where you want it

games.title: BELFRY
games.alt: Bats wheeling over a dark town under a thin crescent moon, the ground made of points of pale light, a house with pink and blue party windows on the far street
games.summary: A bat on Halloween night. It’s dark, and you only see what makes a sound. The colony left for the winter roost while you were asleep, and they’re hunting all over town on the way. Find them. Every one you find clicks too, so the more of you there are, the more you can see. Keyboard and mouse, or two thumbs on a phone held sideways.
games.metaDescription: BELFRY is a first-person browser game about being a bat on Halloween night, where the only light is sound. The colony has gone on ahead; find them across the town, the cemetery, the woods, the river and the storm, and get everyone home before morning. Keyboard and mouse, or two thumbs on a phone held sideways.
games.controls: mouse steers · hold left mouse or W to beat your wings · right mouse or Space to shout (it calls the others and turns owls) · S brakes · Esc pause · M mute · F full screen · phone held sideways: left thumb steers, hold the right to beat your wings, tap it to shout

games.title: STRUNG
games.alt: A tightrope walker with a long balance pole, seen from behind, halfway across a rope between two buildings on a rainy night, hundreds of lit windows, a DINER sign on the left, the moon over the roofs
games.summary: A tightrope across a city at night, eight ropes from roof to roof to the clock tower. Every rope is a string and your feet play it. Lean and it goes out of tune. There’s a net until there isn’t. Mouse, or two thumbs on a phone.
games.metaDescription: STRUNG is a browser game about walking a tightrope across a city at night, eight ropes from roof to roof to the clock tower. Every rope is a string and your feet play it. Lean and it goes out of tune. Mouse, or two thumbs on a phone.
games.controls: hold the mouse button to walk · move the mouse left and right to balance (the side the cursor is on gets heavier) · click as you fall to catch the rope, hold to climb back · on a phone, hold the right side to walk and slide a thumb on the left side to balance

games.title: FETCH
games.alt: A cracked skull held in two hands as a wet, long-haired figure climbs through a ruined window from a moonlit graveyard
games.summary: You wake up holding a skull you cannot get rid of. Thrown, it zips straight back — it is the key, the weapon, the only light, and the last thing you want in your hands. The bedroom door is locked from the inside, and the way out is down.
games.metaDescription: FETCH is a browser first-person horror game about a cursed skull that always comes back — key, weapon and lamp through a locked house, a graveyard, and a forest that seals behind you.
games.controls: WASD move · mouse look · hold LMB throw / release to return · tap RMB or E call it back · Shift run · Space jump · E use · Esc or P pause

games.title: No Moon
games.alt: A moon-headed figure at the centre of a vast dark arena firing a cyan spread outward through concentric rings of violet and gold shot, a huge grinning moon overhead
games.summary: They warned you about the Moon. You didn’t listen.
games.metaDescription: No Moon is a fast browser twin-stick roguelike about moon-headed Passengers descending through sealed rooms beneath a missing sky.
games.controls: WASD or arrows + mouse · twin-thumb touch

games.title: THROWN
games.alt: Two pale hands reaching toward each other in the dark, a small warm light held in the lower palm
games.summary: The only way up a dark tower is other people’s hands. Hold one to hang from it, lean to swing, and let go to fly. Held, let go, thrown — at the top it is the same number.
games.metaDescription: THROWN is a browser game about climbing a dark tower on other people’s hands. Hold to hang on, lean to swing, let go to fly. Plays on desktop and on a phone.
games.controls: Hold space, click or touch to catch a hand · A D, arrows or drag to lean · let go to fly · Esc or P pause

games.title: VIGIL
games.alt: A rifle firing across a moon flat toward a lit relay tower with two ramps, spider-legged machines charging in from every side, under a ringed planet and a violet eclipse
games.summary: One rifle, one deck, ten watches. They come across the flat and up the ramps. The eclipse overhead is the only clock you get.
games.metaDescription: VIGIL is a browser horde-mode first-person shooter about holding one relay deck on a dead moon through ten waves while an eclipse crosses the sky.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · LMB fire · RMB sights · R reload · V melee · Shift sprint · Ctrl crouch or slide · Space jump

games.title: THE EATEN PATH
games.alt: A moonlit forest path closing between twisted trees, watched by eyes in the trunks and recorded on VHS
games.summary: Every path you take eats itself. Walk forward through an infinite nighttime forest while the route seals behind you, the camcorder keeps recording, and the trees watch.
games.metaDescription: THE EATEN PATH is a first-person horror walk through an infinite nighttime forest where every route seals behind you.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · two-thumb touch · Shift to hurry · headphones recommended

games.title: Rocket Shoes
games.alt: A small white ghost in galaxy-patterned rocket boots grinding a gold rail in a burst of sparks high above a neon city, two paler ghosts trailing behind
games.summary: Rocket boots, glowing rails, an endless neon city — never touch the brakes.
games.metaDescription: Rocket Shoes is a browser arcade game: grind the rails, dash the rooftops of an endless neon city, and never touch the brakes.
games.controls: Keyboard + mouse · gamepad · two-thumb touch

games.title: Skyshard
games.alt: A glowing cyan weapon held at the edge of frame, looking out across a snowfield of black pines toward a towering blue crystal and a lighthouse, shards floating under a green aurora
games.summary: Five small lands under one strange sky — and every boss you beat teaches your body a new move.
games.metaDescription: Skyshard is an open-world FPS with five lands, strange doors, and the things that wait behind them.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · two-thumb touch · click to fire

games.title: Behind You
games.alt: Red faceted heads with pale staring eyes hanging in a ring around a cracked, glowing floor, closing in from every side
games.summary: Hold your nerve in the dark and outlast the things closing in from every side. Every run is a race against your best time — last long enough and you've Held Hell.
games.metaDescription: Behind You is a first-person survival horror game in the browser: hold your nerve in the dark and outlast the things closing in from every side.
games.controls: Desktop only · WASD + mouse

games.title: Glide
games.alt: A flying squirrel gliding between colossal sunlit trunks
games.summary: Drift through an endless, sun-dappled forest as a tiny flying squirrel.
games.metaDescription: Glide is a wordless flying-squirrel forest toy from Qualiacology.
games.controls: WASD + mouse

games.title: Rally
games.alt: A round magenta rival mid-swing on a sunset court, the ball arcing overhead
games.summary: The swing is the shot, and the music only lives while the ball's in the air. Climb five rivals across one summer to a finale you play instead of win.
games.metaDescription: Rally is a mouse-only tennis duel where the swing is the shot and the music only lives while the ball does.
games.controls: Mouse only · click to toss, swing through the ball

games.title: ARC
games.alt: A skater grinding a streak of amber light hanging over black water at night, its reflection beneath, a small black bird racing back along the line
games.summary: There's no road until you throw one. You carry a swift whose tail is made of light: throw it and the tail hangs in the air as a rail. Ride the rail. It ends in mid-air over black water, so call the swift back — it eats the road on the way — and catching it at speed throws you into the next throw. Three big slow animals in the way, and a dam at the end.
games.metaDescription: ARC is a browser skate game in a drowned valley at night. Throw a swift whose tail hangs in the air as a grind rail, ride it, call it back along its own line, and the catch flings you into the next throw.
games.controls: Hold left mouse to throw, longer for further · skate onto the tail to ride · right mouse to call it back · WASD skate, lean, tuck, drag a foot · Space hop or pop off · M mute · Esc pause

games.title: Tideglass
games.alt: A figure on a stone quay over a still sea, a chained weight swung out to one side, facing a gateway of stained glass under two towers
games.summary: A chained glass weight, a flooded glassworks, and a way out to the sea. Draw the weight along the ground or stand it up, turn the capstans until the water drops, and break whatever the sea engine is hiding behind.
games.metaDescription: Tideglass is a desktop action game in the browser: draw a chained glass weight through stained glass, turn the capstans to drop the water, and open a flooded glassworks to the sea.
games.controls: Desktop only · WASD move · hold LMB and draw the weight · hold RMB to raise it · Space double jump · hold E for a lifting ring · R reel in · arrows, middle drag or screen edge to turn the view

games.title: STARSTRUCK
games.alt: A cemetery at night under a full moon and a sky of stars and thin cloud: a tall marble obelisk on a lit plinth in front, a columned mausoleum on the left, a small chapel with its two windows lit, a colonnade with a car parked beyond it, and palms against the sky on the right
games.summary: A survival game with an addictive level-up system. One night in the Hills: mansions, a studio backlot, a cemetery, a waterfall you can walk through, the dead always coming, and bosses that come at certain intervals, in certain places. A gun in the right hand, a throwing star in the left, XP that soars into you like a magnet, and a skill tree in the sky that keeps what you've placed. How long can you survive. Keyboard and mouse.
games.metaDescription: STARSTRUCK is a fast first-person survival shooter: one night in the Hills, with mansions, a studio backlot, a cemetery and a waterfall, the dead always coming, bosses on a schedule and an addictive level-up system. How long can you survive. Keyboard and mouse.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · Space jump, again in the air, hold to climb · Shift run, in the air dash · C crouch, running slide · click fire, right click aim · Q throws the star, hold to spin · F kick · 1 2 3 or wheel guns · R reload · Tab the tree

albums.title: Whoever You Are
albums.summary: Seven tracks. A claw machine of rubber ducks, the quietest mall in the world, an empty lifeguard chair in September, and Maho Bay, for whoever you are.

albums.title: I Miss The Summer People
albums.alt: I Miss The Summer People album cover
albums.summary: Six tracks about the people who were around all summer and aren’t now. A drained pool, a flip phone at the bottom of the deep end, and a closer called AI GF.

albums.title: You Are Here
albums.summary: Pop-punk, hyperpop, and a spoken-word opener nobody asked for. Eight tracks about people who only figure out where they were standing once they’ve already left.

albums.title: Ask Anyone
albums.summary: Pop, pop-punk, and emo — some lyrical dissonance and some truth. The one where the hooks aren’t covering for anybody.

albums.title: Anthropic-Omorphizing
albums.summary: The machine-heart record. Love, loneliness, and large language models — written with the thing it’s about. Fifteen tracks that survived a release, a suspension, and a homecoming; no computers anywhere in the lyrics. The machine stays in the furniture.

albums.title: Summer People
albums.summary: A Doopliss album: sunlit hooks with something wrong under the deck chairs. Summer shimmer, social rot, and a grin that knows exactly where the bodies are sunscreened.

albums.title: Immortalized
albums.summary: The one where redemption was never on the table and the songs are the receipt. He doesn’t repent — he gets remembered. Lacquered into permanence by the same glossy hooks that should have buried him.

albums.title: Hate Fuck Hotline
albums.summary: A feral dispatch from the Doopliss emergency broadcast system. Dial in, regret it later, and don’t pretend you weren’t warned by the title.

albums.title: Pretty Guilty
albums.summary: The one where the verdict was never in question but the sentencing keeps getting delayed. Gorgeous on the surface, rotting underneath, and completely okay with it.

albums.title: Bite Marks & Bubblegum
albums.alt: Bite Marks and Bubblegum album cover
albums.summary: The one that smiles with perfect lipstick while the floor drops out underneath you. Glossy hooks, bruised undertones, and the exact second attraction starts looking like self-destruction.

albums.title: Death Threats & Makeup Sex
albums.alt: Death Threats and Makeup Sex album cover
albums.summary: The big one. Twenty-eight tracks of the entire toxic cycle on repeat — the fight, the fuck, the apology, the amnesia, the relapse. The album that proves love and destruction share a zip code.

albums.title: Cherry Lipstick (And Other Red Flags)
albums.alt: Cherry Lipstick and Other Red Flags album cover
albums.summary: A glittering field guide to attraction, denial, and knowing better about five seconds too late. Romantic comedy energy with a switchblade hidden somewhere in the purse.

albums.title: Thick Thighs, Sweet Lies
albums.alt: Thick Thighs, Sweet Lies album cover
albums.summary: The candy-apple one. Body heat, bad decisions, and compliments you should have read the fine print on. Every sweet thing on this record is load-bearing.
